flat_monitor_gate_work_baseline.reason: scripts/flat_baseline.py instruments the committed SafetyGate.check to count gate evaluations per call for ORASR (adaptive) vs a flat monitor (all gates every call) on the seed-42 synthetic cohort. On that cohort ORASR=2.5 vs flat=4.0 evals/call -> 37.5% gate-work reduction and 1.60x work-normalised throughput. The same arithmetic on the MIMIC action mix (58.1/31.5/10.4%) gives 1.94 evals/call, matching the manuscript's analytic 1.94 vs 4.0 (51%). These are host-INDEPENDENT integers.

synthetic_gate_removal_ablation.reason: scripts/ablation.py runs progressive gate removal with a deterministic per-gate failure-injection suite (1,000 scenarios / gate, seed 42) on the SYNTHETIC cohort and reports coverage loss (undetected fault fraction) per configuration. Output results/ablation.csv|json. Each gate's removal leaks exactly its own fault type (coverage_loss 1.00); the full G1-G4 stack leaks 0.

mimic_iv_retrospective_distribution.reason: scripts/extract_mimic.py reads a user-supplied MIMIC-IV copy, maps actions to risk via a transparent rule table, and emits the routing distribution -- but no MIMIC data is committed and the manuscript's 8,412 actions @ 58.1/31.5/10.4% are NOT hardcoded. They must be regenerated by a user with credentialed PhysioNet access; absent data the script exits without fabricating.

manuscript_latency_literals_and_mimic_la.reason: Absolute wall-clock latency (per-pathway 2.3/45.2/287.5 ms and the ~84-86% ms latency reduction / 7.3x speedup) depends on host hardware/load and on the MIMIC action mix. The gate-work reduction is reproduced as the portable invariant; absolute-ms reductions and any MIMIC-weighted latency / MIMIC-based ablation latency column remain host- and credentialed-data-specific and are NOT copied as literals here.

gate_pass_rate_98_7.reason: The committed gate validators pass for well-formed inputs, so a clean synthetic cohort yields a 100% pass rate. The 98.7% rate and the 130-block breakdown depend on a failure-injection / malformed-input mix that is not committed and is not reconstructed here (no tuning to match the paper).
